title: Is my hat in the bag?
scene: 找帽子，逐处确认在不在。

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Is my hat in the bag?

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: The red one. It's not here.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: There it is. How'd it get there?

variations: "hat" 换 "gloves"；"in the bag" 换 "on the shelf"。
